title: Critic-Free Pretraining for Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.10473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Offline-to-online (O2O) reinforcement learning aims to leverage policies pretrained on static datasets while improving them through online interaction. However, directly reusing an offline-trained critic can hinder online fine-tuning: as the policy and data distribution change rapidly, value estimates inherited from offline training may become misaligned with the online environment, leading to inaccurate policy improvement and inefficient exploration. To address this problem, we introduce Critic-Free Pretraining: an efficient paradigm that completely abandons the approach of offline critic training, allowing a freshly initialized critic to adapt without inheriting biased estimates. CFP is compatible with various mainstream O2O algorithms and consistently matches or improves upon conventional O2O algorithms across a diverse set of tasks, with particularly pronounced gains on several challenging tasks.

translated_title: 无评论家预训练：高效在线强化学习微调方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.10473v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：离线到在线（O2O）强化学习旨在利用在静态数据集上预训练的策略，并通过在线交互来改进它们。然而，直接重用离线训练的评论家可能会阻碍在线微调：随着策略和数据分布快速变化，从离线训练继承的价值估计可能与在线环境不一致，导致策略改进不准确和探索效率低下。为解决这一问题，我们引入了无评论家预训练（CFP）：一种高效范式，完全摒弃离线评论家训练的方法，允许新初始化的评论家在不继承偏差估计的情况下适应。CFP与各种主流O2O算法兼容，并在多种任务上始终匹配或优于传统O2O算法，尤其在若干具有挑战性的任务上表现突出。
tldr: 本文提出无评论家预训练（CFP）范式，通过放弃离线评论家训练，避免偏差估计继承，从而提升离线到在线强化学习微调的效率和性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Critic-Free Pretraining (CFP), a paradigm that abandons offline critic training to avoid biased estimate inheritance, enhancing efficiency and performance in offline-to-online reinforcement learning fine-tuning.
